items.title: Agentic Pipelines is generally available: run agents in Cloud or on your own Linux runners
items.summary: We’re excited to announce that Agentic Pipelines is now generally available across all paid Cloud Bitbucket plans. You can run agents on our cloud runners or on self-hosted Linux Docker runners, with support for more runner types coming soon. With this launch, Bitbucket Pipelines evolves from a CI/CD tool into an intelligent workflow engine that […]The post Agentic Pipelines is generally available: run agents in Cloud or on your own Linux runners appeared first on Inside Atlassian.
